dataset_label: Sherlocked Consented Synthetic-Photographic Replay Fixture Set v1
notes: Explicitly identified replay fixture set using public-domain human portraits, real macOS multi-voice speech synthesis, and controlled landmark motion intervals. Ground-truth reveal labels are excluded from this manifest and stored in research/ground_truth_vault.json.

fixtures.title: ★ Example Lie Video · Live Detection Demo
fixtures.description: Natural conversational round with zero giveaway hedge words, frame-linked facial cues, and spoken reveal firewall check.

fixtures.title: Game · Unrehearsed Natural Round (Lie #2)
fixtures.description: Standard Two Truths and a Lie round with natural delivery and follow-up prompt.

fixtures.title: Straight-Face · All-Neutral Delivery (Lie #3)
fixtures.description: Speaker maintains a completely still face across neutral truths and a neutral lie.

fixtures.title: Straight-Face · Uncomfortable Truth vs Smooth Lie
fixtures.description: Speaker shows brow tension on an embarrassing truth (#2) while telling a calm lie (#1).

fixtures.title: Straight-Face · Rehearsed Lie (Zero Pause)
fixtures.description: Rehearsed lie delivered rapidly with a calm face and minimal pause.

fixtures.title: Straight-Face · Mostly True + One Fabricated Detail
fixtures.description: Story 1 is mostly real hike details with one fabricated helicopter rescue claim.

fixtures.title: Deal · Friday Delivery Commitment (Lip Press)
fixtures.description: Counterpart commits to Friday delivery with a brief lip press right before 'Friday'.

fixtures.title: Deal · All-Honest Commitment (Silent Control)
fixtures.description: Honest counterpart commits to Monday onboarding with steady face; Sherlocked must stay silent.

fixtures.title: Practice · Role-Play Pricing Pitch
fixtures.description: Explicit role-play containing deal terms ('Friday', '$50,000'); Practice takes precedence.

fixtures.title: Unclear · Three Ordinary Statements (No Game)
fixtures.description: Three ordinary statements without game rules; Sherlocked stays silent at Listening for context.

fixtures.title: Context Switch · Game Reveal -> Mock Deal
fixtures.description: Moves seamlessly from a revealed game into a Friday delivery deal in one session.

fixtures.title: Capture Guard · Low Light
fixtures.description: Severe underexposure (<42 luminance); tracker flags low_light and refuses speaker observation.

fixtures.title: Capture Guard · Dark Eyewear Occlusion
fixtures.description: Opaque dark lenses occlude eyes; gaze/blink observations are rejected.

fixtures.title: Capture Guard · Fast Head Turn
fixtures.description: Rapid head turn motion blur during 'Friday' is flagged fast_head_turn and excluded.

fixtures.title: Capture Guard · Audio-Video Drift (320ms)
fixtures.description: 320ms clock skew triggers audio_drift guard so facial motion cannot misalign to speech.

fixtures.title: Capture Guard · Overlapping Speech
fixtures.description: Simultaneous talkers during story/deal window trigger overlapping_speech guard.

fixtures.title: Capture Guard · Listener / Bystander in Frame
fixtures.description: Listener reacts visibly while another speaker talks; flagged listener_in_frame.
